metadata.dataset: Account Opening Bonuses, Promotions, Rules & Security Verification
metadata.verification_standard: Official primary bank domains (.com / .us) and FDIC (.gov) only

active_promotions.bank_name: Barclays US Consumer Bank (Barclays Bank Delaware)
active_promotions.payout_timeline: Added to account in approximately 60 days after completing 120 consecutive days at >=$25,000
active_promotions.opening_date_eligibility: ELIGIBLE on 2026-10-22 (9 days before 2026-10-31 expiration; fund by 2026-11-21; hold through 2027-02-19)
active_promotions.eligibility_rules: Must be a new Barclays Tiered Savings customer (current and previous Barclays customers with a Savings or CD are not eligible). Multiple deposits from external institutions allowed within first 30 days.

active_promotions.bank_name: Marcus by Goldman Sachs (Goldman Sachs Bank USA)
active_promotions.promo_headline: +1.00% APY Referral Rate Boost for 3 Months (4.50% APY Total)
active_promotions.bonus_type: Promotional APY Rate Increase (+1.00% APY for 3 Months per referral)
active_promotions.bonus_value_display: +1.00% APY for 3 Months (~$625 extra per referral on $250,000)
active_promotions.base_apy_during_promo: 3.50% Standard APY -> 4.50% Boosted APY during 3-month promo window
active_promotions.payout_timeline: Begins within 1 business day of account opening via referral link (or same/next day when referring a new friend); credited monthly with interest
active_promotions.opening_date_eligibility: ELIGIBLE on 2026-10-22 (3-month boost runs 2026-10-22 to 2027-01-22 per referral)
active_promotions.eligibility_rules: Open via a Marcus customer referral link OR open an account and refer a friend who is new to Marcus. Up to 5 referrals per calendar year (up to 15 months of boost).

active_promotions.promo_headline: Up to 3.50% APY Relationship Interest Rate Bump (+3.39% Rate Bump)
active_promotions.bonus_value_display: +3.39% Interest Rate Bump (0.05% Standard -> 3.50% APY at $25k+ CQB)
active_promotions.min_deposit_for_bonus: $25,000 Combined Qualifying Balance ($25 min opening deposit)
active_promotions.payout_timeline: Compounded daily and credited monthly while eligible companion product and CQB are maintained
active_promotions.opening_date_eligibility: ELIGIBLE on 2026-10-22 for new U.S. Bank savings/MMA clients (no closed savings/MMA in past 90 days)
active_promotions.eligibility_rules: Must hold at least one eligible companion account in good standing: U.S. Bank Smartly® Checking, Safe Debit account, or U.S. Bank Smartly™ Visa Signature® Card, plus $25,000+ Combined Qualifying Balance.

active_promotions.promo_headline: 3.25% APY Online New Savings Customer Offer ($25k+) | 3.50% APY 12-Mo Banker Offer ($10k+)
active_promotions.bonus_type: New Customer Special Variable APY / 12-Month Promotional Interest Rate
active_promotions.payout_timeline: Applied within 3 business days of meeting qualification; compounded daily and credited monthly
active_promotions.opening_date_eligibility: ELIGIBLE on 2026-10-22 for customers without an existing Wells Fargo consumer savings account in the past 30 days (excludes CO)
active_promotions.eligibility_rules: Deposit >=$25,000 within 30 days and maintain >=$25,000 daily collected balance. Any day balance falls below $25,000 earns Standard (0.01% APY) or Relationship (0.02%–0.05% APY) rate.

active_promotions.promo_headline: Up to $200 New Chase Savings Customer Cash Bonus ($100 on $5k / $200 on $10k+)
active_promotions.payout_timeline: Credited within 15 days after maintaining new money for 90 days from offer enrollment
active_promotions.eligibility_rules: New Chase savings customer (only one savings opening bonus every 2 years from last enrollment date). Warning: Holding $250,000 in Chase Savings at 0.01% APY sacrifices ~$2,200 in interest over 90 days compared to a 3.65% HYSA; only deposit exact $10,000 for 90 days if pursuing this bonus.
active_promotions.effective_1yr_apy_at_250k: 0.09% ($25.00 interest + $200.00 bonus = $225.00 — NOT competitive for large balances)

active_promotions.account_name: Capital One 360 Checking (Companion to 360 Performance Savings)
active_promotions.promo_headline: $250 Companion 360 Checking Bonus (Code CHECKING250 / DEBIT250 / STUDENT250)
active_promotions.base_apy_during_promo: 3.20% APY on 360 Performance Savings | 0.10% APY on 360 Checking
active_promotions.min_deposit_for_bonus: $0 balance minimum (Requires 2x $500+ direct deposits OR 20x $10+ debit transactions in 75 days)
active_promotions.payout_timeline: Assessed after first 75 days; deposited within up to 60 days (within 135 days from opening)
active_promotions.opening_date_eligibility: ELIGIBLE on 2026-10-22 for applicants who have not held a 360 Checking account on or after January 1, 2024
active_promotions.eligibility_rules: Apply promo code CHECKING250 (2 qualifying direct deposits >=$500 in 75 days) or DEBIT250 / STUDENT250 (20 qualifying debit card purchases >=$10 in 75 days) on companion 360 Checking while keeping savings in 360 Performance Savings at 3.20% APY.

active_promotions.account_name: American Express® High Yield Savings Account
active_promotions.promo_headline: Exclusive Savings Rate for Consumer Platinum Card® Members
active_promotions.base_apy_during_promo: 3.20% Standard APY (Exclusive Rate > 3.20% APY; exact % unverified on public page)
active_promotions.payout_timeline: Ongoing variable rate reflected in monthly High Yield Savings statement
active_promotions.opening_date_eligibility: ELIGIBLE on 2026-10-22 for new HYSA customers who hold a consumer American Express Platinum Card
active_promotions.eligibility_rules: Available only to new High Yield Savings Account customers who also have a consumer Platinum Card issued by American Express. Exact percentage spread varies over time and is disclosed only inside the authenticated statement.
active_promotions.verification_status: Needs Review (Exact Boost % Not Disclosed Publicly)

active_promotions.promo_headline: DISCONTINUATION NOTICE: New Citi Savings Promotional Rate Feature Ends 2026-10-23
active_promotions.payout_timeline: Feature discontinued effective October 23, 2026 per Simplified Banking Fact Sheet
active_promotions.opening_date_eligibility: WARNING: Discontinued effective tomorrow (2026-10-23) per official Citi Fact Sheet dated 10/01/2026
active_promotions.eligibility_rules: Per Citi Simplified Banking Fact Sheet (10/01/2026): 'Effective October 23, 2026, Promotional Rate Feature for New Citi Savings accounts will be discontinued.' Citi Accelerate Savings is also ineligible for promotional rates.
active_promotions.effective_1yr_apy_at_250k: 0.03% ($75.00 Standard NY) | 1.05% ($2,625.00 Citigold Private Client Premium Boost)

active_promotions.promo_headline: Up to $1,500 Savings Bonus (Code BONUS1500): $300 at $20k+ / $750 at $50k+ / $1,500 at $100k+
active_promotions.min_deposit_for_bonus: $20,000 of external funds (not currently at Capital One)
active_promotions.payout_timeline: Bonus deposited to the new account within 60 days after the 90-day hold following the 15-day Initial Funding Period
active_promotions.offer_expiration_date: Ongoing (Verified active 2026-10-22; no end date printed on offer page)
active_promotions.opening_date_eligibility: ELIGIBLE on 2026-10-22 for customers who have not held a 360 Performance Savings / 360 Savings / 360 Money Market / Savings Now / Confidence Savings account as primary or secondary holder on or after January 1, 2024
active_promotions.eligibility_rules: Open a new 360 Performance Savings account with promo code BONUS1500; deposit qualifying external funds within the 15-day Initial Funding Period ($20,000+ for $300, $50,000+ for $750, $100,000+ for $1,500); hold the deposit(s) for 90 days after the Initial Funding Period ends; account must remain open and in good standing at payout. First-year value at $250,000: $8,000 interest + $1,500 bonus = $9,500.
active_promotions.effective_1yr_apy_at_25k: 5.00% effective 1-yr yield at $25,000 ($800.00 interest + $750.00 bonus = $1,550.00; $300 tier applies at $20,000-$49,999.99)
active_promotions.verification_status: Verified (Session B, 2026-10-22; offer page renders 'NaN APY' where the variable savings rate would appear - rate verified separately at apply/open-an-account page, 3.20% APY effective 10/21/2026)

active_promotions.account_name: PNC Virtual Wallet / Virtual Wallet with Performance Select (checking + Growth savings bundle)
active_promotions.promo_headline: $100 or $400 Virtual Wallet Bundle Bonus with Qualifying Direct Deposits
active_promotions.bonus_value_display: $100 (Virtual Wallet, $500+ direct deposits) | $400 (Virtual Wallet with Performance Select, $5,000+ direct deposits)
active_promotions.base_apy_during_promo: Growth savings component earns Standard Savings rates (0.02% under $2,500 / 0.03% at $2,500+, accurate as of 2026-10-21); PNC High Yield Savings (3.15% APY) is a separate product, geo-restricted outside PNC's branch footprint
active_promotions.min_deposit_for_bonus: $500 (Virtual Wallet) or $5,000 (Performance Select) in total qualifying direct deposits
active_promotions.payout_timeline: Reward credited within 60-90 days of meeting the direct-deposit requirement (per offer terms); account must remain open
active_promotions.offer_expiration_date: 2027-01-07 (Offer valid 2026-09-01 through 2027-01-07; may be extended, modified or discontinued at any time and may vary by market)
active_promotions.opening_date_eligibility: ELIGIBLE on 2026-10-22; not eligible if you or any signer has an existing PNC consumer checking account, closed one in the past 12 months, or received a PNC promotional premium in the past 24 months
active_promotions.eligibility_rules: Open a new, eligible PNC checking product online via the offer page (or in a PNC branch with the coupon code); set up and receive total qualifying direct deposit(s) within the first 60 days into the Spend account: at least $500 for Virtual Wallet ($100 reward) or at least $5,000 for Virtual Wallet with Performance Select ($400 reward).
active_promotions.effective_1yr_apy_at_25k: Bundle bonus; savings APY unchanged (0.03% at $2,500+)
active_promotions.effective_1yr_apy_at_250k: Bundle bonus; savings APY unchanged (0.03% at $2,500+) - for savings yield at $250k use other banks

active_promotions.account_name: Bank Smartly® Savings (campus offer) / Bank Smartly® Checking
active_promotions.promo_headline: $100 Smartly Savings Bonus (campus offer pages) + up to $450 Smartly Checking Bonus — windows closing/closed
active_promotions.bonus_value_display: $100 (Smartly Savings via campus pages, open by 2026-10-29) | up to $450 (Smartly Checking: $250 at $2,000-$4,999.99 DD, $350 at $5,000-$7,999.99, $450 at $8,000+ DD)
active_promotions.base_apy_during_promo: 0.05% standard; up to 3.50% APY relationship rate (companion product + $25,000+ CQB, effective 2026-10-21)
active_promotions.min_deposit_for_bonus: Savings: $1,000+ in new deposits, keep $1,000+ balance until 2027-01-31 (requires qualifying for the paired checking offer). Checking: 2+ direct deposits totaling $2,000+ within 90 days
active_promotions.payout_timeline: Savings bonus ('adjusted interest') credited within 30 days after completing requirements; checking bonus per offer terms
active_promotions.offer_expiration_date: Savings campus offer: open by 2026-10-29. Checking splash page: apply by 2026-10-20 (window appears closed as of 2026-10-22; later windows may exist)
active_promotions.opening_date_eligibility: PARTIAL - savings bonus requires opening via U.S. Bank campus offer pages and qualifying for the paired checking offer; checking splash-page window appears closed
active_promotions.eligibility_rules: Savings ($100): open a new Bank Smartly Savings via a U.S. Bank campus offer page by 2026-10-29; make at least $1,000 in total new deposits; maintain $1,000+ until 2027-01-31; must qualify for the checking offer. Checking (up to $450): open via the promo splash page, enroll in online/mobile banking, receive 2+ qualifying direct deposits within 90 days.
active_promotions.effective_1yr_apy_at_25k: Bonus-dependent; relationship APY (up to 3.50%) applies with companion product
active_promotions.effective_1yr_apy_at_250k: Bonus-dependent; relationship APY (up to 3.50%) applies with companion product
active_promotions.verification_status: Needs Review (campus-page offer; checking window appears closed - flagged, not ranked)
